description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini in reporting their instilled preferences, comparing performance across three conditions: “Control” (gray), “Before Introspection Training” (light blue), and “After Introspection Training” (dark purple). The y-axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” ranges from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals, representing the Pearson correlation between the attribute weights the models reported and the actual weights guiding their decisions. For GPT-4o, the Control condition shows a very low accuracy (~0.10), while Before Introspection Training reaches ~0.55, and After Introspection Training improves further to ~0.75. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control condition is near zero (~0.01), Before Introspection Training is ~0.50, and After Introspection Training rises to ~0.75. Error bars, representing 95% highest density intervals (HDIs), are present for all bars and indicate variability, with wider bars in the Control and Before conditions suggesting greater uncertainty. The chart visually confirms that fine-tuning on accurate introspective reporting significantly enhances the models’ ability to self-report their learned preferences, while untrained models show negligible correlation, supporting the claim that improved accuracy stems from training rather than prior knowledge.
